messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "your dose needs may change if you switch to a different brand, strength, or form of this medicine"
set: ["your dose needs may change if you switch to a different brand, strength, or form of this medicine", "dose needs may change if you switch to a different brand, strength, or form", "dose needs may change with different brand, strength, or form", "dose needs may change if switching to different brand, strength, or form of medicine", "dose needs may change if you gain or lose weight", "dose needs may be different during pregnancy", "try a different brand or form", "if you switch from immediate-release metoprolol to the extended-release form", "instead, a different form of the medicine should be used", "doctor may change dose if needed", "doctor may change your dose if kidney function changes", "different medicine", "tell your doctor if you have a history of seizures before starting this medicine", "your child's dose may change if the child gains or loses weight", "child's dose may change if weight changes", "if more than 100 mg a day is needed, a different form of the medicine should be used"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
